home.lead: Verified professional drivers and insured vehicles, booked, paid and managed by RideWELL from pickup to drop-off.
home.driverText: For evenings out, long days of meetings or a trip upcountry, an approved RideWELL driver takes the wheel of your own vehicle.
driverTicks: Licence, references and driving test checked
Driver arrives with a trip PIN only you know
home.chauffeurTitle: Our vehicle. Our driver. Your schedule.
home.chauffeurText: An inspected, insured vehicle with an approved chauffeur for business days, events and guests.
chauffeurTicks: See your driver, car and plate before pickup
One price, quoted before you pay
home.airportText: Meet-and-greet arrivals and calm departures, with the driver's details sent to you ahead of time.
airportTicks: Flight details noted with your booking
home.howTitle: One request. We handle the rest.
home.step1Text: Pickup, destination, date and time. It takes under a minute.
home.step2Text: Our operations team checks availability and sends one clear price.
home.step3Text: MTN MoMo or Airtel Money. Your booking is confirmed only when payment is verified.
home.step4Text: See your driver, car and plate in advance. The trip starts with your PIN.
home.whyTitle: Trust you can check, not just read.
home.why1Text: ID, licence, references, interview and a driving test before anyone drives for RideWELL.
home.why2Text: Insurance is tracked to the day. A vehicle with expired cover can't be booked.
home.why3Text: Drivers see your details only for a paid, assigned trip, and only while it lasts.
home.why4Text: A real operations team in Kigali watches every trip and answers you on WhatsApp.
home.partnerText: Professional drivers and owners of well-kept vehicles: apply online, upload your documents, and our team will guide you through approval.
home.footerLine: Centrally managed, premium transport in Kigali, Rwanda.
home.priceIndicative: Indicative. Your exact price comes with your quote.
